data.app_name: London Walking Like A Tourist - VR Travel
data.description:
Experience London through the eyes of a tourist on a nearly 2-hour immersive journey.

A Day in London – Real Time Experience: Whether you have an hour or a full day, this app lets you explore London for almost 2 hours. No long planning—just dive right in and feel like you're walking the streets of London. Perfect for a quick virtual getaway, it fits seamlessly into your day.

Pack Your Virtual Backpack and take a spontaneous day trip! No stress, no planning—start from bustling Victoria Station to the majestic Buckingham Palace, stroll across the Mall to the Horse Guards, and enjoy iconic red buses and the sights of the city. Discover hidden corners and flow with the tourists.

Escape from Home: Break free from routine, launch the app, and jump into the lively streets of London. Hear the city’s sounds, from the rumble of buses to the hum of conversations, and soak in the real atmosphere of this fascinating city.

Feel Like a Tourist: Not a guided tour or information overload—this app gives you the feeling of freely exploring the city, just like a real tourist. Experience the meditative joy of wandering the streets with all the impressions of a real visit.

Start your 2-hour virtual day trip now and immerse yourself in the streets and life of London.
